adjudication.subject: PR #1275
adjudication.finding: Focused tests injected capsule/packet doubles while the default compositor attempted top-level imports for canonical Zero modules that actually live under research_entity/global/j-space/implementations/.
adjudication.risk: Component tests could pass while exact repository composition fails before admission.
adjudication.observed_followup: PR #1275 added explicit repository-path loading and a default dependency regression after review.

adjudication.subject: PR #1283 -> merged donor repair #1279
adjudication.finding: The standalone route draft could allow ADAPTIVE_BACKEND to select local-latent J-Space modes from profile configuration without an independently admitted capability contract.
adjudication.risk: Provider/profile text could claim local activation/private latent access before inference evidence exists.
adjudication.observed_followup: PR #1283 was closed donor-only; PR #1279 merged a conservative MINI_INFERENCE_CAPABILITY_BINDING/v1 that ignores provider/model names and requires local activation plus BUNDLED_MANIFEST or RUNTIME_PROBE evidence kind for local modes.

adjudication.subject: merged PR #1279 / tools/mini_inference_capability_binding_v1.py
adjudication.finding: The merged capability binder validates capability_receipt_digest only as a non-placeholder SHA-256 and validates the declared evidence kind, but does not resolve that digest to the same MiniUnifiedDB cognition boot ancestry, actual bundled manifest/model/tokenizer/J-Space identities, or an independently validated runtime-probe receipt.
adjudication.counterevidence: The existing MiniUnifiedDB cognition boot binding already revalidates admitted BUNDLED_MANIFEST, LOCAL_MODEL_CHECKPOINT, TOKENIZER, JSPACE_PROFILE, lens, calibration and source-lock objects for the current generation; the JSPACE_GWT_BOOT_BINDING validator separately cross-binds manifest/checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/J-Space/lens/calibration bytes.
adjudication.risk: A profile can structurally declare capability_evidence_kind=BUNDLED_MANIFEST and provide an arbitrary well-formed capability_receipt_digest; structural capability validation alone is therefore insufficient to grant local-latent runtime admission.
adjudication.required_repair: Before BUNDLED_LOCAL_08B local-latent admission, causally cross-bind the capability evidence to the exact same current-generation prepare/boot ancestry or to an independently validated runtime-probe contract. Do not manufacture a second state/evidence authority.

adjudication.subject: PR #1284
adjudication.finding: The parallel materializer did not consume the canonical cognition_invocation selector, did not cross-bind route capability to exact admitted ancestry, and omitted provenance identities already carried by PR #1275.
adjudication.observed_followup: PR #1284 was closed unmerged and reset to current main; no unique implementation remains.

adjudication.subject: PR #1287
adjudication.finding: The later compositor resolved only ACTIVE_COGNITION_TURN, did not prove the caller cognition_invocation selector against that active turn, mutated global sys.path for dependency loading, and carried a narrower provenance envelope than the current #1275 lineage.
adjudication.useful_donor: Deep-copy the candidate inference object before packet/admission binding so later source-profile mutation cannot alter admitted downstream bytes.
adjudication.observed_followup: PR #1287 was closed donor-only during this go to preserve one pre-inference compositor.
